topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe this. We've been friends for so long, and they just pull something like this? Every time we chatted, they painted this perfect picture of their job, and all along, it was a lie. I guess I should have seen the signs, the times they'd get vague or change the subject. Now, I’m questioning everything we’ve talked about. It hurts, more than I thought it would. I don’t know how to face them, or if I even want to. How do you move past something like this?
